records.title: Bitstamp suffers major hot-wallet breach
records.summary: Bitstamp said operational wallets were compromised, resulting in the loss of less than 19,000 BTC; services were suspended while infrastructure was rebuilt.
records.significance: The breach reinforced the importance of cold storage and operational security after Mt. Gox.

records.title: Coinbase raises $75 million Series C
records.summary: Coinbase announced a $75 million Series C with investors including DFJ Growth, NYSE, USAA and BBVA.
records.significance: It was then the largest funding round for a Bitcoin company and a strong signal of traditional-finance interest.

records.title: Coinbase launches regulated US Bitcoin exchange
records.summary: Coinbase launched Coinbase Exchange, initially available across 24 US states or territories.
records.significance: It marked a move toward more regulated domestic exchange infrastructure in the United States.

sources.title: Coinbase — Launches First Regulated Bitcoin Exchange in US

records.title: Nasdaq launches blockchain initiative for private markets
records.summary: Nasdaq announced an enterprise blockchain initiative initially aimed at private-market equity infrastructure.
records.significance: A major stock exchange publicly experimenting with blockchain signaled institutional interest beyond cryptocurrency trading.

records.title: Ross Ulbricht receives life sentence in Silk Road case
records.summary: Ross Ulbricht was sentenced to life in federal prison after his February conviction on seven counts related to Silk Road.
records.significance: The sentence became one of the most consequential criminal-justice events in Bitcoin's early history and fueled a long-running clemency movement.

sources.title: US DOJ — Ross Ulbricht sentenced to life

records.title: New York BitLicense takes effect
records.summary: New York's virtual-currency licensing regulation became effective on 24 June 2015.
records.significance: BitLicense became one of the earliest comprehensive state-level crypto licensing regimes and influenced which companies served New York customers.

records.title: Ethereum mainnet launches
records.summary: Ethereum's Frontier genesis launched on 30 July 2015.
records.significance: The programmable smart-contract network went live and would later underpin ICOs, DeFi, NFTs and DAOs.

records.title: CFTC treats Bitcoin and virtual currencies as commodities
records.summary: In the Coinflip enforcement action, the CFTC held that Bitcoin and other virtual currencies are commodities under the Commodity Exchange Act.
records.significance: The finding established a central pillar of US federal regulation for crypto derivatives.

records.title: Blockstream announces Liquid sidechain
records.summary: Blockstream announced Liquid as a production federated sidechain aimed at faster Bitcoin settlement between exchanges and market participants.
records.significance: Liquid became one of the most important early Bitcoin sidechains and a long-running experiment in federated Bitcoin scaling.

records.title: Linux Foundation launches Hyperledger
records.summary: The Linux Foundation launched the Hyperledger collaborative blockchain effort in December 2015.
records.significance: Hyperledger institutionalized open-source enterprise distributed-ledger development outside permissionless cryptocurrency networks.
